blocks.text: Jazz guard Keyonte George signed a multi-year extension Friday, securing for Utah a key element in their rebuilding project. The club did not announce the terms, but ESPN reported it was a five-year, $157.5 million extension. The deal takes him through the 2031-32 season. “Keyonte’s leadership, growth, and commitment to what we’re building make him an integral part of this franchise’s future,” Austin Ainge, Jazz president of basketball operations, said in a statement. “His work ethic, ability to connect with teammates in the locker room and on the floor, and his love for this team and our fans have been incredible […]...
